content: Blepharoplasty, canthoplasty, or related procedures are indicated when ALL of the following are present:

children.content: Eyelid problem requiring treatment, as indicated by 1 or more of the following:
Ectropion, with evidence of symptomatic corneal exposure (eg, excessive drying, tearing, irritation, foreign body sensation, keratitis, corneal ulcer)
children.question: Is there evidence in the patient's medical record of ectropion with symptomatic corneal exposure, such as excessive drying, tearing, irritation, foreign body sensation, keratitis, or corneal ulcer?

children.content: Entropion, when local measures fail to control symptoms such as eye pain or corneal irritation
children.question: Does the patient have entropion with symptoms such as eye pain or corneal irritation that are not controlled by local measures?

children.content: Exposure keratitis due to 1 or more of the following:

children.question: Does the patient have eyelid laxity with exposure keratitis or an eyelid problem requiring treatment?

children.content: Inability to properly close eye due to Bell palsy or other disorder
children.question: Does the patient have an inability to properly close the eye due to Bell palsy or other disorder? If yes, left or right?

children.content: Postoperative complication (eg, absence of part of eyelid from previous surgery)
children.question: Is there documentation of a postoperative complication, such as the absence of part of the eyelid from previous surgery, in the patient's medical record?

children.content: Ptosis of lid or dermatochalasis, as indicated by 1 or more of the following:

children.question: Does the patient have congenital ptosis with amblyopia?

children.content: Margin reflex distance 1 (MRD1) less than or equal to 2 mm in central gaze
children.question: Is there documentation in the medical record of a margin reflex distance 1 (MRD1) less than or equal to 2 mm in central gaze, associated with ptosis of lid, dermatochalasis, or an eyelid problem requiring treatment?

children.content: Margin reflex distance 1 (MRD1) less than or equal to 2 mm in down gaze with impairment of reading
children.question: Does the patient have a margin reflex distance 1 (MRD1) less than or equal to 2 mm in down gaze with impairment of reading due to ptosis of lid or dermatochalasis?

children.content: Visual field testing shows superior visual field loss of 12 degrees of vision or 24% impairment.
children.question: Does the patient's visual field testing show superior visual field loss of 12 degrees of vision or 24% impairment in the context of ptosis of lid, dermatochalasis, eyelid problem requiring treatment, or the need for blepharoplasty, canthoplasty, or related procedures?

children.content: Preoperative ophthalmologic examination has been performed.
children.question: Has a preoperative ophthalmologic examination been performed for blepharoplasty, canthoplasty, or related procedures?
